data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 780 reported a net strengthening of prior year claims reserves in 2015. Using the gross claims development (claims triangle) the movement in prior underwriting years is estimated as an adverse development (strengthening) of approximately 38.8 million (in the report currency). This movement primarily reflects adverse development on older underwriting years (circa 2011-2013) driven by large/ catastrophic property losses and other adverse claims development and influenced by reinsurance recoverability movements. The closing gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 (sum of by-year estimated balances) was ~348.5m; the prior-year deterioration accounts for most of the movement from the opening position.

data.data_quality_notes: Extraction is from scanned images. Primary authoritative figures (balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative) could not be unambiguously read; a gross claims development triangle (page 27) was used to compute prior year development (+38.847m) and closing gross outstanding (sum of by-year estimated balances  348.483m). Opening reserves were derived (closing - movement) = 309.636m. Currency inferred from statement headers showing '$000'. Premium mix was approximated by separating 'Reinsurance acceptances' (explicit) and all remaining direct business aggregated to match total gross written premium; line names and amounts are best-effort and have low/medium confidence. Where explicit gross movement note was not clearly legible, the triangle-method figure was used (confidence 0.8).
